item.title: Only $500 And Nine Months To Figure It Out | Natalie Kaminski EP 56
item.description: Natalie Kaminski shares her story of arriving in the U.S. at 18 with just $500, hustling through tech jobs, and climbing her way from QA engineer to COO, before founding JetRockets and leading it through explosive growth and global relocation.Natalie talks about learning on someone else's dime, why embracing what you do best matters, the real impact of AI on tech agencies, and how she faced the ultimate test... moving her entire team out of Russia when war broke out.

item.title: What I Wish I Knew Before My First Business Sale | Brent Peterson | Entrepreneur Intel
item.description: Brent Peterson built and sold his company just as the world was changing.It's when he found out... Owners can’t stay on as the core of the business. item.title: Hard Truths From Founders Who’ve Hit A Growth Ceiling | Patrick Thean | Entrepreneur Intel

item.title: 20-Person Company That Operates Like 200 | Stephen Wojno
item.description: Stephen Wojno took a bankrupt company from $7 million to $28 million by age 26. He ran a 300-person manufacturing operation. Now he's the Chief Intelligence Officer at Stealth Consulting building AI systems for small businesses.Steve said something that stopped me cold.AI can already do 47% of your workload. You just need to know how to point it in the right direction.Most businesses think AI will solve all their problems the moment they turn it on. It won't. You have to train it like an intern.
